name: Nguyễn Khải Nam
tagline: I keep production boring — reliable pipelines, observable systems and infrastructure that scales without drama.
summary: DevOps Engineer with 1+ year of hands-on experience. I operate ~76 production servers running Docker-based microservices and blockchain full nodes, build CI/CD with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, run Prometheus/Grafana observability, and automate incident triage with AI agents. Co-author of two Q1 journal papers on route optimization.

projects.name: NotifyForYou
projects.description: A minimal 24/7 uptime monitor: enter a domain, get an email the moment it goes down.
highlights: Checks every 60s and retries before alerting, which cuts false alarms from transient blips.
Debounced alerts, one per real incident, with recovery notices and up-since tracking.
Pluggable notifiers (SMTP, Telegram, Discord); Node.js + SQLite.
GitHub Actions builds the Docker image and ships it to a VPS over SSH for one-click deploys.
